summary: Formatting 1.2 with precision 31 overflowed the internal 32-byte ArrayString. The fix caps internal precision at 28 and appends remaining zeros in Display. Blocked under the single-region schema: restoring the original overflow logic also restores the helper's scalar return type, requiring corresponding reversals in src/decimal.rs and src/serde.rs. Reversing only Display's padding branch would cause truncation instead of reproducing the historical overflow. The fix adds the detecting test named below. No builds or tests were run.
